SELECT s.* FROM ts_agent_chat_session s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.session_status != 'deleted'
AND ( s.session_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.session_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.session_summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND s.session_status = #{sessionStatus}
ORDER BY COALESCE(s.last_message_at, s.updated_at) DESC, s.id DESC
SELECT s.* FROM ts_agent_chat_session s WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.session_status != 'deleted' LIMIT 1
